{{Top|leg}}
'''MCS''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] technology [[Company/Legends|company]] that focused on the manufacturing of mainframe units.<ref name="guide" />

==History==
While the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] took place, the firm arranged a competition for [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]]. With this contest, MCS tried to figure out which one of the competitors could dismantle their newest and best product the quickest. It was probably a marketing-sketch for MCS to prove that their products are unsliceable.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Unsliceable?}}</ref>

During the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it maintained a warehouse in the [[warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]] of [[Tal'cara]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. A young [[programmer/Legends|programmer]] who shortly worked there, [[Torel Fey'jia]], used his [[slicer/Legends|slicing]] skills to embezzle money from the company. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref>According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''[[Shadows of the Empire]]'' occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> the company went out of business.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
